Escape releases selection and cancelling editing clears its highlight.
Failed saving retains the editor, full draft and focus; switching does not open another editor.
Cancelled delayed double-click requests cannot reopen an editor later.
The selected toolbar wins DOM hit testing against an overlapping later note and remains clickable.

limits: Browser DOM, mouse operations and screenshots verified. Touch/pen events are synthetic. Native Obsidian and physical tablet not operated in this run.
